lesson: Retrospective accounting of the six completed runs of this exact selected snapshot: total tokens were 2031758 versus baseline 2158546 (5.8738% less), but total elapsed time was 1452.831195s versus 1352.851230s (7.3903% more). The predefined sum-of-task-medians gain was 15.8466%, and paired portfolio median gain 10.1928%. Preserve all definitions; the numeric-check repair is a real cost. Do not describe this as an overall speedup or net savings.
limitations: Coordinator review of the completed portfolio and current selected bytes, not a new post-adoption Agent task, independent third-domain transfer, or actual bill. Three repeated samples per task; the full optimization cost is only a measured lower bound.
next_probe: When a genuinely new authorized task arrives, retrieve this cost review with the strategy and numeric-validation counterexamples; measure its full delivery and cumulative cost before broader promotion.
